host.cpu_source: owner-provided public label, updated after measurement; not independently verified benchmark hardware metadata

protocol.dns: real CLI, A+AAAA, no enrichment/permutations/deep-passive, automatic exports included
protocol.dns_warmups: one discarded healthy/loss run per binary; stress cases have no discarded runs
protocol.order: paired current/baseline; order reverses on alternating repetitions
protocol.js: current-source stage only, real HTTP fixture, 32 pages/50 scripts/20ms reply delay
protocol.rss: Child /proc/PID/status VmHWM sampled every 2ms, KiB; may miss the final interval
protocol.wait4_rss: OS lifetime peak also recorded; may include inherited Python RSS before exec
protocol.timing: process launch to exit; verification and fixture setup/teardown excluded
protocol.statistics: median and min/max; no percentile estimate from small samples
